bead.title: Emit cohort terminal records per member
bead.description:
PROBLEM: `CohortFinalize` and `CohortExpired` are synthesized as a single queue-scoped record, so the member items that actually transitioned to terminal state never get per-item history rows.
ROOT CAUSE: `crates/pqueue-engine/src/command.rs:801-808` and `crates/pqueue-engine/src/command.rs:866-873` both return `queue_scoped_change_record(...)`, while the exhaustive synthesis matrix at `crates/pqueue-engine/src/command.rs:1394-1490` still encodes that stale shape.
PROPOSED FIX: Emit one terminal change record per affected cohort member for both `CohortFinalize` and `CohortExpired`, using the command envelope or derived member set to keep emitted history faithful; update the cohort cases in the synthesis matrix to assert item-level terminal rows.
NON-SCOPE: do not change cohort formation, claimability, lease handling, or the apply-side terminal transition rules.
Governing artifact: `docs/helix/04-build/PHASE-7-reconciliation.md` (TD-008 CL-1).
bead.acceptance:
1. `TestCohortFinalizeSynthesizesPerMemberTerminalRecords` asserts that each cohort member gets its own terminal record for `CohortFinalize`.
2. `TestCohortExpiredSynthesizesPerMemberTerminalRecords` asserts that each expired cohort member gets its own terminal record for `CohortExpired`.
3. `TestChangeRecordSynthesisCohortVariants` updates the exhaustive synthesis matrix so the cohort cases expect per-member terminal records.
4. `go test ./crates/pqueue-engine/...` passes.
5. `lefthook run pre-commit` passes.
